flags.message: The snapshot records a July 14, 2026 reply, but the provisioned documents contain only the petition, QP and BIO. The reply could materially answer the State's preservation and vehicle objections. Prediction completed without it; those objections are treated as contested, not established. Consider provisioning reply text for fully briefed cert cells.

A general-precedent CourtListener MCP search was throttled (HTTP 429; stated retry delay 729 seconds), and general web attempts supplied no usable content. Completed using the provisioned papers and committed statpack without independently verifying the parties' cited precedents. No outcome material was obtained and no REST fallback was used.
